# Route validation matrix

<!-- Generated by `node spikes/vue3-migration/route-matrix.mjs` from the two routers and `route-matrix.json`. Edit the JSON, not this file. -->

V02 ([#1284](https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/issues/1284)) asks for a documented matrix that maps every shipped route to its V07–V11 work package and a validation method, including manual hardware checks. This is that matrix for the routes in `src/modules/navigation/router.ts` and `src/sidepanel/router.ts` in the working tree. The owner is the route component's primary work package from `routes.mjs`, the same rule as the V01 inventory; V04 owns redirects and catch-alls.

The ESLint Config Gate workflow runs `route-matrix.mjs --check`, so a route added or renamed without an entry in `route-matrix.json` fails the PR. Add `--e2e <checkout>` locally to confirm each E2E spec exists at the pinned harness and names its route.

## How each route is checked

- **unit**: Vitest spec in this repository (npm test) that mounts the route's view or drives the logic behind it. Source-text tripwires are not listed.
- **guards**: src/modules/navigation/router.guards.spec.ts drives the production router: it proves where the route lands (auth, network, feature flag, redirect), not that its view renders. route-matrix.mjs checks the spec pushes the route (in the side-panel block for a side-panel route).
- **help-browser**: scripts/help-browser scenario run by the optional Help browser evidence workflow when Help, shared UI or build files change (not a required check).
- **harness**: scripts/migration-browser harness: drives the real packaged extension in Chromium with production messaging and persistence (no state overrides).
- **e2e**: Playwright spec in the external harness, run against an exact wallet SHA.
- **manual**: Needs a device, a live provider, mainnet or funds; record the result in the V13 signoff.

E2E references are paths under `tests/specs` in [Gero-Labs/gerowallet-e2e-tests](https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet-e2e-tests) at harness `b5a00dc3`, whose wallet pin is `e8a3d139`. They are not checked out here, so route-matrix.mjs checks only their shape; rerun the harness against the exact candidate in V13 (#1295). A check marked funded skips without a funded testnet wallet and is not coverage until that run has one.

## Summary

- 54 routes: 46 options, 8 sidepanel.
- By owner: V04 4, V08 10, V09 8, V10 5, V11 27.
- 50 routes render a view; 4 are redirects or catch-alls, covered by the guard spec or a manual step.
- 36 of the 50 views have a check that renders them without a funded wallet (unit, Help browser or E2E).
- 14 views rely on the manual step: `options:/nexus`, `options:/governance/dreps/:drepId`, `options:/copilot-feed`, `options:/dev-tools`, `options:/wc-session-proposal`, `options:/warning`, `options:/ledger-ble-sign`, `options:/ordinals`, `options:/mempool`, `options:/lightning`, `sidepanel:/staking`, `sidepanel:/market`, `sidepanel:/perps`, `sidepanel:/feed`.
- Of those, 3 have the guard spec, which proves where the router lands but not that the view renders, and no check that renders them: `options:/ledger-ble-sign`, `sidepanel:/staking`, `sidepanel:/feed`.
- 4 routes have browser coverage only in specs that skip without a funded wallet: `sidepanel:/staking`, `sidepanel:/market`, `sidepanel:/perps`, `sidepanel:/vaults`.
- 36 routes list a manual step (device, live provider, mainnet or funds) for the V13 signoff.

## Behaviours

V02 also asks that behavioural cases cover async validation, approve/reject/cancel exactly once, worker restart, lock/unlock, two open UIs and wallet/network switching, and that unoverridden login/lock, switching, broadcast and restart/persistence coverage is assigned to V05 with exact-candidate reruns in V13 (#1295). 11 behaviours, 9 with a stated gap. Each check names its test after ›, written in full as in its file: `--check` fails if a local test is renamed or deleted, and `--e2e` does the same for E2E titles, which CI does not run, so a behaviour needs a check in this repository or a stated gap.

| Behaviour | Owner | Checks | Gap |

| Async validation: pending blocks repeat actions; a stale result is discarded | V08 | unit: `modules/dashboard/dialogs/ChangePasswordDialog.spec.ts` › cancels before mutation if %s changes during form validation<br>unit: `modules/navigation/dialogs/BackupWalletDialog.spec.ts` › never decrypts if %s changes during form validation<br>unit: `shared/composables/useTransactionSigning.spec.ts` › awaits Vuetify validation and blocks repeated clicks while pending; false never signs<br>unit: `sidepanel/components/DAppOverlay.spec.ts` › runs repeated password clicks in one flight and signs only the approved payload<br>unit: `sidepanel/components/flows/SendSheet.spec.ts` › requires a new approval after replacement and serializes repeated clicks<br>e2e: `08-post-v27/signing-cancellation.spec.ts` › ${cancellation} during password verification cannot sign the abandoned request @post-v27 @offline | Only unit tests assert the blocked, one-flight state; the browser test covers discarding the stale result. |
